decision: Task created: Harden optional coordination CI and stacked PR validation
rationale: A requested feature/task was registered with acceptance criteria. Follow-up to T005.

decision: Require strict optional coordination CI while allowing only recorded pruning
rationale: A passing dependency-free self-test may intentionally skip optional tests, and main-only PR filters omit stacked PRs. A standard-library presence check plus a strict component runner makes CI evidence explicit without adding dependencies or changing service behavior.
alternatives: Treating any absent add-on folder as pruned could hide incomplete checkouts.
Using ordinary self-test alone could report success when all optional tests skipped.
A separate duplicate workflow would add maintenance without improving coverage.
outcome: All PR targets trigger CI; each job has a 15-minute limit; status checking requires explicit workflow prune metadata for absent components; retained components require imports, schema freshness, and nonzero, non-skipped successful tests. User approved the prerequisite maintenance brief correction and local North Star publication, preserving task history and keeping the reusable template free of a root vision file.

decision: Task completed: Harden optional coordination CI and stacked PR validation
